description: This file is a shell script that runs performance tests for the 'diff' command with various options, particularly focusing on the 'diff --color-moved' feature. It sources an external library file and performs git diff and git log commands with different parameters to measure performance.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up the default repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with the specified description and command.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test sequence.

methods.name: test_export
methods.description: Exports environment variables for the test.
